Ana — thanks, received. Quick confirmation items from procurement/finance side:

1) Redwood's PO workflow requires either a US TIN (EIN) for US-tax-reportable vendors OR a valid W-8BEN-E plus a bank letter confirming account ownership and country of residence.
2) If GlobalForge is routing payments to an Irish entity (GlobalForge Holdings Ltd.), we need the legal name on the invoice to match the name on the W-8BEN-E.
3) If the signer on the W-8BEN-E is different from the authorized signer in your banking docs, procurement will ask for a signed delegation of authority.

Can you: (a) confirm the exact payee legal name you will invoice under, (b) share the signed bank letter, and (c) if available, the delegation PDF (signed) for the person who will approve invoices?

I copied Kimberly (payments) and Priyom (vendor onboarding) to coordinate PO staging. Once we have the bank letter and either the delegation or notarized CFO signature, procurement can move the PO to conditional-release status pending verification.
